# edgeos_service_ssh (Resource)

The SSH server (`service ssh`). There is one per router; the resource takes over the existing settings and the ID is always `ssh`.

The resource owns every attribute below: one you leave out gets its default, so the configuration describes the whole SSH server. Other options below `service ssh` are left alone. When `service ssh` is missing (SSH switched off), create switches it on.

Destroying the resource never switches SSH off. It puts the port back to 22 and the protocol to `v2`, listens on all addresses again and removes `disable-password-authentication`, `disable-host-validation` and `allow-root`. To switch SSH off, delete `service ssh` with `edgeos_config` or by hand.

**Lockout risk.** A wrong value here can cut off SSH access to the router: `disable_password_authentication` without a working key (see `edgeos_system_login_user_public_key`), a `port` the firewall does not allow, or `listen_addresses` that are not on the interface you connect through. The provider itself uses the web UI, not SSH, so it keeps working and can undo the change.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Add a working key before turning password logins off.
resource "edgeos_service_ssh" "this" {
  port                            = 22
  listen_addresses                = ["192.168.1.1"]
  disable_password_authentication = true
  disable_host_validation         = true

  depends_on = [edgeos_system_login_user_public_key.alice_laptop]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `allow_root` (Boolean) Allow logins as `root` (`allow-root`). Defaults to `false`.
- `disable_host_validation` (Boolean) Do not look up the client's host name in DNS (`disable-host-validation`), which makes logins faster when DNS is slow or missing. Defaults to `false`.
- `disable_password_authentication` (Boolean) Only allow public key logins (`disable-password-authentication`). Add a key with `edgeos_system_login_user_public_key` first. Defaults to `false`.
- `listen_addresses` (Set of String) Local IPv4 or IPv6 addresses the SSH server listens on (`listen-address`). Unset listens on all addresses.
- `port` (Number) TCP port of the SSH server. Defaults to `22`.
- `protocol_version` (String) SSH protocol version: `v2`, `v1` or `all`. Defaults to `v2`; protocol 1 is insecure.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `ssh`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = edgeos_service_ssh.this
  id = "ssh"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import edgeos_service_ssh.example 'ssh'
```
